description: Query real-time web, REST API, and MCP JSON-RPC traffic attribution telemetry across acquisition channels, AI agent harnesses, MCP tools, and countries. Use this tool with Allometrik administrator credentials to inspect live funnel conversions, tool invocation volume, and agent harness breakdown. Returns aggregated traffic counters, channel attribution tables, per-tool call distribution, and recent telemetry events.

limit.description: Maximum number of recent live telemetry events to include between 5 and 100 (default: 25).

window_hours.description: Lookback time window in hours between 1 and 720 (default: 24).

name: traffic_analytics
title: Admin Traffic & MCP Attribution Telemetry
